title: TLS terminated in front of mimid; http allowed for tests
description: protocol-06 §5.1: the directory conveys HTTPS URLs. mimid listens on plain HTTP and expects a TLS-terminating proxy in front; config base_url and peer addresses accept http:// so offline tests run without certificates. Production deployments must use https base_url. Consistent with mimid-1wgh.17 (no inter-provider auth; no mTLS conformance claimed).
